265:t_1:4.en:
$$セイミー$$
「...Huh, $$正太郎$$ and $$ワッ太$$... Aren't you two getting seconds?」

265:t_1:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm just not very hungry today, for some reason.」

265:t_1:7.en:
$$セイミー$$
「That's unusual. Do you have a fever or something?」

265:t_1:9.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「You two... you're worried about the food stockpile, aren't you?」

265:t_1:11.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「I'm $$ルゥ・リルリ$$, you know... I'm not a psychological counselor just for show.」

265:t_1:12.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Guess there's no point hiding anything from her...」

265:t_1:13.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...I can't help worrying. When I think about what happens if we have to keep traveling with no way to get more food...」

265:t_1:14.en:
$$正太郎$$
「So I figured I'd cut back, even if only a little...」

265:t_1:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「Thanks, you two. That's an admirable way to feel.」

265:t_1:17.en:
$$ランド$$
「But listen! They say you can't fight a war on an empty stomach. Eat while you can!」

265:t_1:19.en:
$$メール$$
「It's fine. $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ and everyone on the daily life team are working all that out carefully.」

265:t_1:21.en:
$n
「Ikue, can I have seconds? Today's mapo glass noodles are really delicious.」

265:t_1:22.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Of course. There's still plenty, so eat up!」

265:t_1:23.en:
$n
「The rice just keeps going down when you're on cooking duty, $$郁絵$$.」

265:t_1:24.en:
$$郁絵$$
「It makes me so happy to hear you say that.」

265:t_1:25.en:
$$スズネ$$
「There you go again, $n... Getting all goofy over an older woman...」

265:t_1:27.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now, now, Miss $$スズネ$$! $n is right in the middle of his youth... Right now, food beats romance!」

265:t_1:28.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Sorry. Your suffocating heat has killed my appetite...」

265:t_1:30.en:
$$メール$$
「But it's good that your fever went down so quickly, $n.」

265:t_1:31.en:
$n
「Times like these... I can't stay in bed forever. ...Oh, is there still enough rice for seconds?」

265:t_1:32.en:
$$郁絵$$
「I'll make it a big helping this time.」

265:t_1:35.en:
$n
「What's wrong, you two? If you don't hurry, there won't be any seconds left for you.」

265:t_1:36.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$n... The $$血塗られた眼$$ showed up again, didn't they.」

265:t_1:40.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What the heck is that!? Eating away the stress!?」

265:t_1:41.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's not good. $$谷川$$ and $$中原$$ said that if you eat like that, your stress doubles afterward.」

265:t_1:43.en:
$n
「...Once there was a kid who got caught up in all kinds of incidents and shut his heart away...」

265:t_1:45.en:
$n
「From morning to night, that kid sat hugging his knees in the corner of his room and spent the whole day doing nothing.」

265:t_1:46.en:
$n
「The kid's father had ignored him all along, but the one thing he wouldn't allow was skipping meals... Do you know why?」

265:t_1:47.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Well, because you'd die if you didn't eat...」

265:t_1:48.en:
$n
「If staying alive were all that mattered, there's always nutrition by IV. But the father didn't want him to forget the strength to live.」

265:t_1:50.en:
$n
「The energy to live... You could call it the will to live.」

265:t_1:51.en:
$n
「Through the act of eating, the father tried to keep him constantly aware of it and make him feel that he was alive.」

265:t_1:54.en:
$n
「The idea of saving food is important. But so that you don't get crushed by anxiety, you should eat properly too.」

265:t_1:55.en:
$n
「A meal someone made for you means more than just nutrition.」

265:t_1:56.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「...$$郁絵$$-chan. Can I have seconds too?」

265:t_1:58.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Sure. I'll make both of yours big helpings.」

265:t_1:59.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$n... I'm going to eat so I won't lose to anything.」

265:t_1:60.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'll eat my rice and do my best. To live... and to get back to Earth.」

265:t_1:61.en:
$n
「All right. You two are at the age where you eat like horses anyway, so don't be shy for no reason.」

265:t_1:62.en:
$$セイミー$$
「So, $n... what happened to that kid in the end?」

265:t_1:63.en:
$n
「...A lot happened after that too, but he's doing fine. He's been blessed with friends and the people around him.」

265:t_1:65.en:
$$ルゥ$$
(Looks like there's no more need to worry about $n's mental state.)

265:t_1:66.en:
$$ルゥ$$
(In that case, the problem is still...)

265:t_1:67.en:
$$赤木$$
「...It's a worn-out saying, but space sure is big.」

265:t_1:68.en:
$$青山$$
「Only you could come out with such a carefree line in this situation.」

265:t_1:69.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're an odd one yourself. Just a salaryman, and yet you've got nerves of steel.」

265:t_1:70.en:
$$赤木$$
「Naturally. Even I dreamed of being an astronaut or a space explorer when I was a kid.」

265:t_1:71.en:
$$赤木$$
「I think I understand that the situation is dangerous. But I can't stop some part of me from getting excited.」

265:t_1:72.en:
$$青山$$
「...Truth is, just between us... me too.」

265:t_1:74.en:
$$青山$$
「Yeah... And, embarrassingly, for the same reason as you.」

265:t_1:75.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't be shy! A man has a boy's heart no matter how old he gets.」

265:t_1:76.en:
$$赤木$$
「Coming to the very middle of the galaxy woke the back-alley space boy inside each of us.」

265:t_1:77.en:
$$青山$$
「Maybe. It surprises even me that there was still a part of me that childish.」

265:t_1:78.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Say what you will, when all's said and done $$青山$$'s one of $$赤木$$'s kind.」

265:t_1:79.en:
$$青山$$
「That remark... I can accept it as my usual short straw, but you'd better not let $$いぶき$$ hear it.」

265:t_1:80.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Right. Even I don't plan on making $$いぶき$$ angry.」

265:t_1:82.en:
$$赤木$$
「Here comes another adult who never lost the heart of a boy.」
